payload.root_cause: Off-by-one comparison bug in Inventory.reserve: pyshop/inventory.py:20 uses a strict `>` (`if self.available(sku) > qty:`) when deciding whether a reservation fits. When the requested quantity exactly equals the remaining stock (available == qty), the condition is False, so control falls into the `else` branch at line 23 and raises OutOfStock even though the reservation should succeed per the method docstring and the README domain rule 'Reserving exactly the remaining stock is allowed.' The condition must be `available(sku) >= qty` so that reserving the final units is allowed while requesting more than available (e.g., 1 available vs 2 requested) still raises OutOfStock.
